summarization:
The smartphone UI screen is titled "My Games" and is divided into two main tabs: "OWN" and "JOINED." The "OWN" tab is currently selected. 

1. **Edit my game propositions**: This section allows users to edit their game propositions, with a note indicating that these can be seen in the user's profile. There is a prominent "+" icon for adding or editing game propositions.

2. **Past Games**: Below the game propositions section, there is an area labeled "Past Games." It features a clock icon and a prompt that says "Tap to load past games (won & lost)," indicating that users can tap this area to view their past game history, including both wins and losses.

The UI is clean and minimalistic, focusing on managing and viewing game-related activities.
